cohort: The study included 153 postpartum patients, comprising both primigravida and multigravida mothers who had either vaginal delivery or LSCS.
finding: Unawareness was identified as the major difficulty and an important cause leading to delayed establishment of breastfeeding in immediate postpartum primigravida and multigravida mothers.
mod_finding: Establishment of feeding occurred earlier (1-4 hours) in mothers with vaginal delivery compared to those with LSCS (>4 hours).
followup_time: immediate postpartum period (within days of birth)
